parts:
B1+ English Listening Test

Watch a video about a teenager who survived a plane crash. For questions 1 to 7, decide if the statements are true or false. You can see the transcription after submitting your answers.

See the full list of B1+ listening tests
Questions

questions.prompt: She never thought she was going to survive.
The plane crashed due to a storm.
After the crash, she tried to rescue her grandfather.
When the plane crashed, she was sleeping.
She could find her way out of the forest thanks to a TV show.
Once she reached the highway, a car took her immediately.
After what happened, it’s hard for her to find the strength to live again.
